$comment: COPY → ~/.paseo-pi-team/jobs.local.json (or edit it in the WebUI under Cấu hình → Công việc). A job is a PRESET a Lead reads with 'pteam jobs list' / 'pteam jobs show <id>'; it seats nothing, and the create_agent gate still checks every seating against the route file. Each job lists one or more executors, and ALL of them are used: kind 'class' = whatever route that MODEL_CLASS has on this host now; kind 'route' = an explicit paseoProvider/model (thinking optional), same shapes as model-routing.local.json; kind 'cli' = a CLI tool, built-in 'pi' and 'claude' or one declared under cliTools. run 'sequential' means in the listed order — never 'try the next one when the previous failed'. Job ids and cliTools names: letters, digits, '_' and '-' only (no dots). Values below are placeholders.
